audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 with 50.06% over 869 games fits a lane you win on foot early and that flips only if you cross an Event Horizon ring.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes is the generic "full kit at 3 / level 6 adds the zone / Luden's" template.
audit.why: His level 6 is Primordial Burst at 120/90/60s, scaling on your missing health at 650 range — that is what changes at 6 and the spike line should say it.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to name the missing-health scaling.

audit.why: The decisive interactions are already stated: only the ring of Event Horizon stuns and a dash out through it stuns you too (report[5].t, dontsFull[2].d, breakdown.cooldowns); Dark Matter lands on a delayed marker you walk off; Primordial Burst grows with missing health. spikes[1].text also correctly corrects the old claim that Between Worlds grants untargetability — it does not.
breakdown.cooldowns carries Event Horizon 20s to 14s, Baleful Strike 6s to 4s, Primordial Burst 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.early, breakdown.carry, breakdown.late and dontsFull[1].d are enemy-agnostic templates.
audit.why: Each has a Veigar-specific fact available: the delayed Dark Matter marker, Baleful Strike last-hits as permanent AP, the 725 cage range against your 900 Q, and never crossing the ring in a late fight.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten at the same length.

audit.why: No elo tiers anywhere in the current text.

edits.before: W spent as an entrance is W unavailable as an exit — the whole kit's promise breaks on that one greed.
edits.after: His cage reaches 725 — trade from 900 and step off the Dark Matter marker, never from inside both.

edits.before: Trade patterns and exits — your early is honest plus an escape hatch. Bank the haste and the lane stays yours to pace.
edits.after: Walk off every Dark Matter marker and Q him on each Baleful Strike step-up — his 20s cage is the only thing that pins you.

edits.before: Carry through tempo — patterns that exit free compound; your zone turns objective fights into speed checks they fail.
edits.after: Carry by starving stacks: every Baleful Strike last-hit is permanent AP, so deny them and shove him off the wave.

edits.before: Full kit at 3 sets the pattern; level 6 adds the zone; Luden's makes the rotation half a bar.
edits.after: Level 3 sets your pattern; his 6 is a missing-health nuke; Luden's makes the rotation half a bar.

edits.before: You warp the fight: R the clump, hop through the middle, and pattern whoever the zone slows. The exit portal is your insurance.
edits.after: Late one cage decides it — never cross the ring, R the fight from outside it, and hold your bar high against his 650 nuke.

notes: Level chart is all-Aurora and agrees across phases[].side, win[] and the packet, so no chart pairs were moved. No report edits made. The packet suspectName 'Your Between Worlds' is a false positive — that is Aurora's real R. Minor inconsistency left alone: tradeGood says 'hop out' while breakdown.trading's copy of the same line says 'walk out'; walking out is the correct advice here since a dash through the ring stuns, so tradeGood is the weaker of the two but is inside the mirror-neutral zone and was not worth a length-band risk.
